info.title: CalendarLink Universal API
info.description: Create and share calendar links, subscription calendars, and RSVPs

post.description: Creates a new event in a CalendarLink organization.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

collectionId.description: Collection ID that owns the event.

rsvp.enabled.description: Whether RSVP is enabled for the event.

start.description: Event start datetime in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format.

end.description: Event end datetime in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format.

rsvp.settings.phoneEnabled.description: Whether phone input is enabled for RSVP.

rsvp.settings.descriptionEnabled.description: Whether the RSVP description field is enabled.

rsvp.settings.descriptionLabel.description: Label shown for the RSVP description field.
